name: @kitstak/entitlements
description: Per-module entitlements for KitStak orgs (BLUEPRINT.md §3, docs/billing/CONTRACTS.md section 8): cached reads of core.entitlements, the access rule (full, view only, locked), manual grants, the full-row writer used by billing, and the dev allow-all switch. No gateway code lives here. TypeScript source-shipped (consumers transpile via Next transpilePackages).
